integrity_notes: Coefficient identities, case proof and exact-rational checker are supplied; independent assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; scalar autonomous decay only; fixed step and one backward-Euler starter; no positivity conclusion for general matrices, nonlinear ODEs or other starters.
The classical kappa=0 boundary is already known; priority risk remains for implicit or unindexed linear-monotonicity specializations.
title: Sharp positivity frontier for optimally damped two-step stiff solvers
